seo.description: Ceramic coating, paint protection film, polishing, interior cleaning and servicing for premium cars in Tashkent. Enclosed bays and a warranty on every job.
seo.answer: Your Company is a detailing studio and car service in Tashkent: ceramic coating from 4,500,000 UZS (1–2 days), full-body PPF from 28,000,000 UZS (4–5 days), polishing from 2,200,000 UZS and interior cleaning from 1,400,000 UZS. We work in enclosed bays; book on +998 71 200-00-31.

sections.title: A shine built for the road
sections.subtitle: Ceramic coating, paint protection film, polishing and service for cars that are cared for seriously. Enclosed bays, studio lighting, a photo report at every stage.

sections.label: Garage
sections.title: We work like an atelier, not a car wash
sections.text: Every car is received by a technician: paint thickness measured, defects photographed, plan and timing agreed. Six enclosed bays with forced ventilation and studio lighting; films and coatings come only from manufacturers with an official warranty. Thirty days after a ceramic coating you get a free check-up wash.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: What we do
sections.intro: Prices depend on the car class and the condition of the paint — we quote exactly after an inspection, which is free.

items.title: Ceramic coating
items.text: Two to three layers of ceramic on body, wheels and glass. Protection from road salt, UV and light scratches.

items.title: Paint protection film
items.text: Polyurethane film on high-impact areas or the whole body; light scratches heal themselves.

items.title: Paint polishing
items.text: Correction or protective polish: we remove holograms, swirls and car-wash marks.

items.title: Interior deep clean
items.text: Leather, Alcantara, headliner; ozone treatment and leather protection afterwards.

items.title: Tinting and heat-rejecting film
items.text: Films within the permitted light transmission, with no bubbles and no dust.

items.title: Routine servicing
items.text: Oils, filters, brakes, diagnostics — genuine parts and a photo report.

items.title: Porsche 911 Carrera
items.text: Matte film over the entire body, ceramic on the wheels and calipers.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz G 63
items.text: Three-layer ceramic coating and leather restoration.

items.title: BMW M5
items.text: Car-wash holograms removed with the clear coat thickness preserved.

items.title: Range Rover
items.text: Bonnet, bumper, headlights and sills — the parts that catch stones first.

items.title: Toyota Land Cruiser 300
items.text: Sound deadening for the arches and doors, heat-rejecting film on the windscreen.

items.title: Inspection
items.text: Paint measurement, defect photos, a work plan and an exact price. Free, 30 minutes.

items.title: Preparation
items.text: Wash, decontamination and removal of parts where needed.

items.title: The work
items.text: In an enclosed bay under studio light; you get photos at every stage.

items.title: Handover
items.text: We show you the result in daylight and hand over a warranty card.

items.quote: They wrapped the 911 in five days, as promised. You can't see the seams even on the edges, and they sent photos every evening.

items.quote: The first service that showed me paint thickness before and after polishing. The price matched the one quoted at the inspection.

items.quote: Two years on, the ceramic still lets the car wash clean with water alone. They invited me back for the check-up wash after a month.
items.author: Alisher

items.q: How long does a ceramic coating last?
items.a: Two to five years depending on the product and the number of layers. The term is stated on your warranty card; we recommend a wash without harsh chemicals every six months.

items.q: Which is better — ceramic or PPF?
items.a: Film protects against chips and stones; ceramic protects against chemicals, UV and light scratches. They are usually combined: PPF on high-impact areas and ceramic on the rest of the body.

items.q: How long will the car stay with you?
items.a: Ceramic takes 1–2 days, full-body PPF 4–5 days, an interior clean one day. We confirm the exact timing at the inspection.

items.q: Can I wash the car right after ceramic?
items.a: For the first 7 days only touchless washing without shampoo; after 30 days we invite you for a free check-up wash.
Yes: the manufacturer’s warranty on film of up to 10 years plus our own warranty on installation and coating — the terms are on the card you receive with the car.

items.q: Do I need to book an inspection?
items.a: It’s best to book by phone or Telegram — the inspection is free and takes about 30 minutes.
